question: Which metal sulphate, composed of potassium, aluminium, and sulphate ions in the ratio 1 ∶ 1 ∶ 2, plays a role as a flame retardant, a mordant and an astringent?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Potash alum__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

 
• Potash alum is **a chemical compound widely used as the potassium sulfate dodecahydrate.**
 
• It is double salt that is used commonly in medicine and the water treatment process. 
 
• Potash alum is also known as potassium alum or **potassium aluminum sulfate**
 
• The chemical formula of potash alum is **K**<span style="vertical-align: baseline; position: relative; to
